articles.title: Iracema Santos: advogada e presa política na ditadura morre | G1
articles.standfirst: Natural de Floriano, Iracema teve atuação marcada pela defesa dos direitos das mulheres e pela resistência à ditadura militar, período em que foi presa e perseguida politicamente.
articles.summary: Natural de Floriano, Iracema teve atuação marcada pela defesa dos direitos das mulheres e pela resistência à ditadura militar, período em que foi presa e perseguida politicamente.
articles.body:
Morre aos 99 anos a advogada e professora Iracema Santos — Foto: Reprodução

A advogada Iracema dos Santos Rocha da Silva morreu nesta segunda-feira (26), aos 99 anos em Teresina. A informação foi divulgada pela Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil, Seccional Piauí (OAB-PI), por meio de uma nota de pesar. A causa da morte não foi divulgada.

Natural de Floriano, Iracema Santos nasceu em 1927 e teve uma trajetória marcada pela atuação na advocacia, no jornalismo e na educação.

Além de professora, procuradora, jornalista e colunista social, destacou-se pela defesa dos direitos das mulheres e pela resistência à ditadura militar, período em que foi presa e sofreu perseguição política.

"Seu legado permanece como exemplo de coragem, compromisso e defesa das liberdades", afirmou a nota.

A associação Piauiense dos Procurados do Estado (APPE), também se solidarizou pelo falecimento de Iracema e destacou que ela foi a primeira mulher a presidir a associação.

"Mulher de coragem e defensora dos direitos das mulheres, deixa um legado de conhecimento, luta e resistência que permanecerá vivo na história e na memória de todos que inspirou", afirmou a nota da APPE.

Em abril de 2025, em reportagem do g1 sobre os 61 anos do golpe militar , a professora Marylu Oliveira, pós-doutora em História pela Universidade Federal do Ceará (UFC), relembrou a trajetória de Iracema Santos durante a ditadura militar.

Segundo a pesquisadora, Iracema foi acusada pelos militares de "comunismo e subversão" e passou a ser alvo de perseguição política .

Ainda de acordo com Marylu Oliveira, Iracema chegou a disputar a Prefeitura de Teresina nas décadas de 1950 e 1960 e presidiu a Liga Feminina Trabalhista. Ela também foi eleita deputada federal em 1970, mas teve o mandato cassado pelo regime militar.

A advogada foi presa e mantida no 25º Batalhão de Caçadores, em Teresina, onde prestou depoimentos aos agentes da ditadura. Após ser libertada, passou a sofrer restrições impostas pelo regime, incluindo limitações ao convívio com outras pessoas.

"Ela foi conduzida a prestar depoimentos no exército no Dia das Mães, o que criou uma situação muito impactante. Se hoje em dia há uma dificuldade importante na introdução das mulheres no espaço político, naquela época era muito incomum uma mulher jovem e aguerrida politicamente", considerou a professora Marylu Oliveira.

Ela foi anistiada pelo governo federal, em 2015, e recebeu uma indenização de R$ 150 mil.

A Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil, Seccional Piauí, manifesta profundo pesar pelo falecimento da advogada Iracema dos Santos Rocha da Silva, aos 99 anos, nesta segunda-feira (26/10).

Além da atuação na advocacia, Iracema construiu uma trajetória de destaque como professora, jornalista e colunista social, tornando-se uma referência na imprensa piauiense por meio da coluna “Agenda Nobre”.

Sua história também foi marcada pela luta em defesa dos direitos das mulheres e pela resistência à ditadura militar, período em que foi presa e sofreu perseguição política, em 1964. Seu legado permanece como exemplo de coragem, compromisso e defesa das liberdades.

Neste momento de dor e luto, a OAB Piauí solidariza-se com os familiares, amigos e colegas de Iracema dos Santos Rocha da Silva, expressando suas mais sinceras condolências e desejando força e conforto a todos que sofrem com esta perda.

Associação Piauiense dos Procuradores do Estado (APPE)

É com profundo pesar que a Associação Piauiense dos Procuradores do Estado (APPE) comunica o falecimento da Dra. Iracema Santos Rocha da Silva, advogada, Procuradora do Estado, jornalista e professora da UFPI.

Primeira mulher a presidir a APPE, a Dra. Iracema dedicou sua vida à defesa dos direitos das mulheres. Foi presa e perseguida durante a ditadura militar, em 1964, e deixa uma história de coragem e resistência.

Mulher de coragem e defensora dos direitos das mulheres, deixa um legado de conhecimento, luta e resistência que permanecerá vivo na história e na memória de todos que inspirou.

A APPE se solidariza com familiares, amigos e com toda a classe dos Procuradores do Estado neste momento de dor.

*Vitória Bacelar, estagiária sob supervisão de Ilanna Serena.

articles.title: Voos internacionais Brasília: Gol suspende rotas para Argentina e EUA | G1
articles.standfirst: A partir de fevereiro, companhia deixará de operar voos de Brasília para Buenos Aires, Miami e Orlando. Número de destinos internacionais com voos diretos do DF cai de 9 para 5.
articles.summary: Voos internacionais Brasília: Gol suspenderá rotas para Miami, Orlando e Buenos Aires em 2027, reduzindo as opções diretas do aeroporto para cinco destinos.
articles.body:
Avião Gol Linhas Aéreas — Foto: Divulgação

O Aeroporto Internacional de Brasília vai perder voos diretos para Buenos Aires , na Argentina , e Miami e Orlando, nos Estados Unidos , a partir de fevereiro de 2027.

A Gol Linhas Aéreas vai cancelar as três rotas como parte de uma readequação da malha aérea. A informação foi confirmada também nesta segunda-feira (26) pela Inframerica, concessionária responsável pela administração do terminal.

De acordo com a Inframerica, a companhia aérea atribuiu a decisão ao aumento do custo do querosene de aviação (QAV), um dos principais componentes das despesas operacionais do setor.

O g1 pediu mais detalhes sobre a decisão à Gol e aguarda retorno.

Com o cancelamento dos voos para Miami e Orlando, Brasília ficará sem ligações aéreas diretas com os Estados Unidos . Segundo a Inframerica, isso não ocorria desde 2009.

Em meio aos cancelamentos, a Gol continuará operando uma única rota direta de Brasília para o exterior – para Bogotá , capital da Colômbia.

A companhia não informou previsão de retorno das operações para os destinos que serão suspensos.

A rota para Cancún ( México ), iniciada em 2024, já havia sido encerrada em agosto deste ano.

Com a mudança, o número de destinos internacionais atendidos por voos diretos no Aeroporto de Brasília cairá de nove para cinco, segundo a Inframerica. Permanecerão as operações para:

Alta do combustível pressiona setor aéreo

No comunicado, a Inframerica afirmou que o cancelamento ocorre em um cenário de pressão de custos para a aviação comercial.

Além da alta do combustível, as companhias aéreas acompanham mudanças tributárias previstas para os próximos anos. Esses fatores têm levado o setor a revisar estratégias e concentrar operações em mercados de maior demanda, segundo a concessionária.

A Inframerica afirmou que continua buscando oportunidades com companhias aéreas nacionais e internacionais para ampliar a oferta de voos para o exterior e fortalecer a conectividade internacional do Distrito Federal.

Gol ampliou voos para Buenos Aires em 2025

Em maio de 2025, a Gol ampliou de cinco para sete o número de voos semanais entre Brasília e Buenos Aires. Na época, a mudança permitiu que o Aeroporto de Brasília passasse a ter voos diretos diários para a capital argentina.

A rota é operada com destino aos aeroportos Jorge Newbery, conhecido como Aeroparque e localizado na região central de Buenos Aires, e Internacional de Ezeiza. O trajeto dura cerca de quatro horas.

articles.title: Ballon d'Or 2026: Lionel Messi, Yamal and Mbappe among favourites; how the winners are decided
articles.summary: The Ballon d'Or winners will be announced on Monday, with a new generation of football stars, led by Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappé, hoping to win the
articles.body: The Ballon d'Or winners will be announced on Monday, with a new generation of football stars, led by Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappé, hoping to win the award that was dominated for years by Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo.At 39, Messi still remains in contention for football's biggest individual honour after his performances at the World Cup. While the focus is increasingly shifting towards a potential Yamal-Mbappé rivalry, Harry Kane's remarkable goalscoring form could delay the start of a new era by another year.The women's award will have a new winner after Barcelona and Spain midfielder Aitana Bonmati, who claimed the honour for the past three years, missed out on the shortlist following a leg fracture in December.Two-time winner Alexia Putellas is the favourite to claim the award for the third time.Here's everything you need to know about the Ballon d'Or, which translates from French as Golden Ball.Where and when is the Ballon d'Or ceremony?The ceremony will take place at the London Palladium on Monday at 2000 GMT (1:30am IST). It is the first time the annual event has been held outside France since 2015 and the first time it will be staged in London.This year marks the 70th anniversary of the awards, which were introduced by French magazine France Football in 1956. The women's Ballon d'Or was established in 2018.The favourites to win the Ballon d'OrFour players have emerged as the leading contenders from the 30-man shortlist for the men's award: Yamal, Mbappé, Kane and Messi. They are competing for the trophy won by Ousmane Dembélé last year.Yamal, who was named the best young player in each of the past two years, is well placed to win his first Ballon d'Or after helping Spain win the World Cup and Barcelona claim the Spanish title.Mbappé, meanwhile, was expected to establish himself as the world's best player long before now. He won the World Cup with France in 2018 at the age of 19, but his position in the Ballon d'Or rankings has slipped in recent years. He finished seventh last year.The French forward had an outstanding individual season last term and also became the highest scorer in World Cup history. However, his inability to lead Real Madrid or France to trophies could count against him in the voting.Kane's case is different. The England captain has broken goalscoring records in Germany while winning titles with Bayern Munich. He was also among the leading performers at the World Cup, where England finished third.Messi refuses to leave the conversationMany expected Messi to fade from the Ballon d'Or race after moving to Major League Soccer (MLS) to play for Inter Miami. However, the Argentine, widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time, has continued to make his presence felt.He guided Miami to their first MLS Cup last season before producing another impressive World Cup campaign with Argentina. Messi helped his country come within one win of securing back-to-back World Cup titles.Argentina eventually lost the final to Spain, but Messi once again played a major role in the tournament.Putellas favourite to reclaim the women's awardPutellas is the favourite to win the women's Ballon d'Or after returning to her best form and helping Barcelona win the Champions League and Spanish title before joining London City Lionesses.The Spain international suffered ligament damage in the past, during which time Bonmati rose to become the leading name in women's football. Putellas now has the chance to return to the top by winning the award for a third time, although Bonmati's absence due to injury means she will not face the three-time defending champion.Other leading contenders include Manchester City forward Khadija Shaw and Barcelona's Claudia Pina.How is the Ballon d'Or decided?The Ballon d'Or winner is determined by a vote, with one journalist from each of the top 100 nations in the FIFA rankings taking part.The criteria include individual and team performances, “decisive and impressive character” and “class and fair play.”Each journalist selects 10 players from the 30 nominees and ranks them in order. The first choice receives 15 points, while the 10th receives one point. The player with the highest total wins the Ballon d'Or.If players finish level on points, the winner is decided by the number of first-place votes. If the tie remains, second-place votes are considered, followed by the subsequent positions.Kane's recent form will not count towards the awardKane has continued to score at an impressive rate, with records falling along the way.Last month, he became the fastest player to score 100 Bundesliga goals, reaching the milestone in just 98 appearances.His form at the start of the season has strengthened his case for the Ballon d'Or. However, there is one important limitation: the voting period ended after the World Cup. The official period ran from August 3, 2025, to July 19, 2026.Kane's performances and trophies during that period have already made him a serious contender. Had the opening weeks of the current campaign also been included, his case for being named the world's best player would have been even stronger.Players with the most Ballon d'Or winsMessi holds the record with eight Ballon d'Or titles, the most recent of which came in 2023. Ronaldo is second with five wins, having last claimed the award in 2017.Michel Platini, Johan Cruyff and Marco van Basten have won the trophy three times each.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Los arranques 'diésel' de Aguirre: cuesta ganar y en el Valencia se repite
articles.standfirst: Misma esencia que con Zaragoza, Leganés y Espanyol mientras que el primer triunfo rápido llegó con el Mallorca, en su segundo duelo... pero ha sabido enderezarlo con el tiempo
articles.summary: Misma esencia que con Zaragoza, Leganés y Espanyol mientras que el primer triunfo rápido llegó con el Mallorca, en su segundo duelo... pero ha sabido enderezarlo con el tiempo
articles.body: Javier Aguirre ha tenido que actuar de entrenador bombero o revulsivo en varias ocasiones en la Liga española. Le ha pasado con una retahíla de equipos. Con el Zaragoza, el Espanyol, el Leganés, el Mallorca y ahora con el Valencia y lo cierto es que llegar a mitad de temporada para reflotar las naves no ha sido tarea sencilla. Porque hay un detalle llamativo que impera en la mayoría de situaciones que ha vivido con sus equipos. Cuesta romper el hielo. Cuesta ganar. Para empezar, con el Valencia lleva tres partidos en los que aún no ha podido hacerse con esa victoria balsámica que cambie el ambiente dentro y fuera del equipo. Porque ha empatado ante el Racing de Santander (2-2) y el Athletic de Bilbao (0-0), pero en su tercer encuentro se quedó con la miel en los labios y perdió en el descuento con el Villarreal (1-2). Por el momento la victoria se le resiste. Esto no hace más que confirmar los arranques 'diésel' que tiene cuando entra en un equipo por emergencias, léase empezada la campaña. Le ha pasado con Zaragoza, Leganés, Mallorca y Espanyol. Fue en la campaña 2010-11. Cogió a un equipo en crisis. Y el triunfo tardó en llegar. 1-1 contra Getafe, derrota ante el Villarreal (0-3), empate ante el Almería (1-1), derrota ante el Real Madrid (1-3), empate ante Osasuna (0-0) y por fin victoria ante la Real Sociedad (2-1). Otro inicio complicado. El partido de Copa lo perdió ante el Sevilla, y luego en Liga se sucedieron estos resultados iniciales: ante el Granada (0-0), ante el Sevilla (2-2), ante el Real Madrid (2-2) y ganó al Dépor (2-0) a la cuarta. Con el Leganés tampoco resultó ser sencillo el comienzo. 1-1 ante la Real Sociedad, derrota (1-2) ante el Barcelona, derrota (1-0) ante el Sevilla y gana al Celta (3-2). Tal vez con el Mallorca haya sido un revulsivo con todas las de la ley. Porque es el equipo con el que ganó más rápido. También es cierto que era 'a vida o muerte'. Perdió su primer partido ante el Getafe (1-0) y ganó al segundo (1-0) al Atlético de Madrid.

articles.title: From 12,000 players assessed to 14 selected for Azerbaijan, how India are building a scouting network to find their next generation of football talent
articles.summary: India's search for the next generation of football talent has taken a step forward, with the country's U-15 team continuing its winning run at the
articles.body: India's search for the next generation of football talent has taken a step forward, with the country's U-15 team continuing its winning run at the inaugural FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival Azerbaijan 2026. The Blue Colts beat Cameroon 2-1 in their second Group K match in Baku on Sunday, but the result is also part of a much bigger effort to identify and develop young footballers across the country.Over the past two years, the All India Football Federation (AIFF) has assessed more than 12,000 players from across India as it looks to identify promising talent and prepare them for the future. The initiative was originally designed to find players born in 2011 and 2012 and develop them through AIFF-FIFA talent academies. The launch of the FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival has given that effort a wider purpose.India have selected 14 players for the tournament in Azerbaijan, but the programme extends well beyond the squad. Many other young footballers have been tracked as part of an effort to build a pipeline of talent for Indian football.The team made a strong start against Cameroon on Sunday. Deepak Singh Arambam's corner in the first minute caused confusion inside the opposition box, with Fareil Ngobo attempting a headed clearance that sent the ball into his own net to give India the lead.Cameroon drew level through an own goal by Muhammad Sohil Khan in the 20th minute at the Hovsan Competition Complex Pitch 1B. India regained the lead in the 27th minute through R Lalremruatfela, while goalkeeper Jenit Ningthoujam made several saves, including stopping a penalty, to help secure the victory.India are now the only team in Group K to have won both their matches so far. Despite the rainy conditions, they managed the closing stages well, held their shape and saw out the game for a second successive win.India will face Grenada later on Sunday before concluding the qualification stage against Bahrain and Senegal on October 26. Their results across the five matches will determine which performance tier they enter in the second phase.Behind this team is a scouting operation led by Bibiano Fernandes, a former India international who earned one cap for the senior national team. Now 49, Fernandes has moved into coaching and is in charge of India's U-15 side.Finding the right players in a country of 1.4 billion people is a task no single coach can manage alone. The AIFF has built a network of 60 talent scouts across different states and regions, who monitor more than 20 football competitions and leagues to identify young players with potential.“These scouts cover youth and school competitions, as well as private tournaments involving academies. They identify talented players, particularly in the U-14 and U-15 age groups, and add them to our database. When they spot someone with real promise, they keep tracking their progress,” Fernandes told Inside FIFA.The process does not end when a player catches a scout's attention. Those identified are assessed over time before a smaller group is invited to camps and trials. Players from Indian Super League club academies also participate, allowing the coaching staff to compare youngsters who have developed in different football environments.This work has helped the coaching staff select the 14 players representing India at the FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival. Their choices were based on more than technical ability, with discipline and the willingness to give their best on the pitch also considered.“Discipline was one of the most important criteria. We were looking for players who would give their all on the pitch. We also assessed their footballing qualities, including their technique, communication and understanding of the game,” said Fernandes.For the 14 players in Azerbaijan, the tournament is an opportunity to test themselves against young footballers from other countries. For the coaching staff, it is also a chance to assess how this generation compares with its international peers and identify the areas in which the players need to improve.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Diomande se consagra en su primer Clásico y pone en un aprieto a Vinicius
articles.standfirst: El jugador de Costa de Marfil hace olvidar al brasileño y se gana su sitio en el tridente
articles.summary: El jugador de Costa de Marfil hace olvidar al brasileño y se gana su sitio en el tridente
articles.body: El Real Madrid sale muy reforzado del Clásico. Mourinho, el primero, y en el campo puede que quien haya salido del Camp Nou por la puerta grande es Yan Diomande. Su fichaje no estuvo exento de ruido, sobre todo por sus 140 millones, y porque le costó arrancar. Diez partidos de Liga después y sobre todo un partido de esta talla confirman que el esfuerzo por este fichaje tenía su lógica. Lo cierto es que el ex jugador ya venía avisando desde que Mou le dio la titularidad ante el Rayo. Repitió ante el Elche y con nota, pero no le bastó para ser titular en el derbi. Sin embargo, regresó al once ante el Villarreal, con gol, y ya no se cayó más. De nuevo ante el Sevilla y otro tanto, un golazo ante el Leipzig en Champions, aunque fue suplente por Vinicius, y notable ante el Barça. Fue una pesadilla constante en ataque y un defensor más en su propio campo. Incansable, como en la remontada en Roma. Fue en Italia donde mandó el primer aviso serio. Primero por la derecha, para asistir a Kylian, pero en la segunda fue un puñal por la izquierda tras quitar Mou a Vini muy pronto (minuto 59 para dar entrada a Espí) en busca de revulsivos y ocupar el costamarfileño ese costado. La baja de cuatro partidos de Vinicius le han dejado además vía libre por el costado izquierdo, donde parece que más cómodo se encuentra el costamarfileño. Un gran fichaje para Mou, pero un debate a la vista, porque ahora mismo es un jugador capital en el tridente de ataque, no solo por lo que ofrece hacia arriba, sino porque es un lujo para el entrenador por lo que aporta defensivamente. Habrá que esperar al regreso de Vinicius para conocer el movimiento de Mourinho. Ayer formó con Mbappé y Güler, que hasta ahora había jugado más atrás. No ha podido estrenarse mejor Diomande en un Clásico. Un caño a Lamine, una jugada polémica por una entrada de Cancelo que pudo dejar al Barça con diez, primordial en el primer gol de Kylian al ganar la línea de fondo. Estuvo en todos lados y Mou solo le quitó del campo para ganar tiempo, en el minuto 94 para que entrara Espí. "En vez de jugar con el 25, juega con el 125 de lo que se ha pagado", comentó Mou tras su buen partido ante el Sevilla. Lo cierto es que el jugador juega ya con menos presión que en el inicio. El Clásico ha sido el mejor ejemplo.

articles.title: Jason Wilcox: Why is director of football in line of fire from Man Utd fans?
articles.summary: With Michael Carrick's position as Man Utd boss under scrutiny, focus has also turned to director of football Jason Wilcox.
articles.body:
As the clock ticked down during Manchester United 's 3-0 defeat by Bournemouth at Old Trafford on Sunday, the home fans made it clear what they thought about director of football Jason Wilcox.

Singing his name along with an obscenity, the message was brutal and to the point. It was sung by a majority of the United supporters, and on more than one occasion.

It came less than two weeks after United defender Lisandro Martinez had launched a blistering attack on the club's hierarchy for not strengthening the squad, with a particular message for Wilcox.

"I expect more from our technical director," said Martinez.

Pressure is growing on United boss Michael Carrick after eight games without a win - their worst run since 2015-16 - and two three-goal defeats in a week.

Howe and Nagelsmann high on Man Utd's list if Carrick sacked

End approaching for Carrick but Man Utd fans make clear who they blame

Wilcox is a former England winger who won the Premier League with Blackburn in 1994-95.

He joined United in April 2024 - initially as technical director after 15 months in a similar role at Manchester City , where he had previously been in charge of the academy.

At City he worked with current United chief executive Omar Berrada and also Stephen Torpey, who was appointed United's head of academy in August 2025.

When he arrived, it was said by United officials that Wilcox would work across all technical areas of the club to achieve "highest standards of performance" and would be answerable to the sporting director.

That changed the following December, when that sporting director - Dan Ashworth - was sacked amid a difference of opinion over who should replace Erik ten Hag as manager.

Ten months on, a poor series of results and dissatisfaction with transfer business has put Wilcox in the spotlight.

There are some who have sympathy with the position Wilcox finds himself in. The 55-year-old is not in charge of transfer budgets, which are set at a higher level.

Wilcox was also - obviously - not responsible for the injury Manuel Ugarte sustained playing for Uruguay at the World Cup, which wrecked a plan to sell the midfielder in the summer to bolster the transfer budget.

Both issues affected the amount United could spend in the summer - both on transfer fees and wages.

Wilcox rarely speaks to the media, although in England that is not uncommon when managers do the vast majority of news conferences.

However a general lack of communication means we don't know why United decided to focus exclusively on strengthening their midfield in the summer, rather than bring in competition at left-back for Luke Shaw and striking support for Benjamin Sesko.

With both players injured, that looks like a major error.

The general consensus is Carrick has been sold badly short, and Wilcox's job title - and the fact he is often photographed with United's new signings and quoted in official press releases - means he is being blamed.

Since arriving at United from Southampton, Wilcox has twice been given very public backing by his bosses.

On the first occasion - around Ruben Amorim's recruitment as successor to Ten Hag - it was Ashworth who lost his job while Wilcox kept his.

Thirteen months later, when Amorim railed publicly against interference around United's formation - identifying Wilcox as one of those responsible - the Portuguese coach went, and Wilcox remained.

Minority owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe is yet to offer his thoughts on the present crisis engulfing Old Trafford, but the United fans delivered their verdict loud and clear during the match against Bournemouth .

There are many reasons why United find themselves 16th in the Premier League and without a win in their past eight matches, but recruitment is one of the bigger ones - and for that, rightly or wrongly, Wilcox is getting the blame.

Since joining United, Wilcox has given one extensive interview - to the in-house Inside United podcast in October 2025.

A month before that, he spoke at the 40th anniversary gala dinner of United's past players' association.

There have been a couple of instances in the past 12 months of him stopping for the briefest of chats with journalists when he walked past an area they were waiting in to speak to a United player after a game.

After the defeat by Bournemouth , Carrick was asked directly if Wilcox and Berrada should speak directly to supporters.

"It's not for me to say who speaks and who doesn't speak, when they speak, and how they speak," said Carrick.

"I know my role here is to speak to you guys and represent the team and football club as best as I possibly can from this position."

There has never been an opportunity to ask Wilcox about the parameters of his role.

But with Carrick's situation as it is - his popularity intact and his status as a legendary figure at the club secure - the focus is moving to Wilcox.

United fans have made it clear they want him out - but does Ratcliffe feel the same?

articles.title: In 2024, Ronaldo sold his 90% stake in Cruzeiro, the Brazilian club he helped rescue; two years later, the football legend bought a $7.8 million Miami penthouse
articles.summary: Football legend Ronaldo makes a significant move into luxury real estate by purchasing a $7.8 million penthouse in Miami after exiting his stake in Brazilian club Cruzeiro, highlighting a shift from sports ownership to premium property investments.
articles.body: In the high-stakes arena where elite sports ownership intersects with luxury global real estate, few figures command attention quite like Ronaldo Luís Nazário de Lima. Famously known across the globe as "O Fenômeno," the two-time World Cup winner has spent the last few years orchestrating a massive, multi-continental shift in his personal and professional portfolio. Between April 2024 and March 2026, the legendary Brazilian striker completely overhauled his assets, pivotally transitioning out of grueling European and South American football club ownership to anchor himself in the ultra-luxury property market of South Florida.This financial evolution reached its crowning milestone on March 30, 2026. Public property records and official media announcements finalized that day confirmed that Ronaldo had completed the acquisition of a breathtaking waterfront penthouse in Miami’s exclusive Bay Harbor Islands for $7.8 million. The transaction came exactly two years after he initiated a high-profile exit from his boyhood club, Cruzeiro, a timeline that underscores a deliberate pivot from the volatile boardrooms of sports management to the rock-solid stability of premier American real estate.Shifting the Playbook: The divestment from football ownershipThe foundation for Ronaldo’s new real estate venture was laid in late April 2024. In a move that shocked the South American football landscape, Ronaldo agreed to sell his controlling 90% stake in the embattled Brazilian club Cruzeiro to BPW Sports, officially announcing the deal across April 29 and 30. Having originally stepped in during a period of acute crisis in 2021, Ronaldo had acquired the indebted club's soccer department for roughly $78 million through a public limited company framework known in Brazil as an SAF (Sociedade Anônima do Futebol). By the time he walked away in 2024, he had negotiated a sale price reportedly hovering around $117 million.Despite bringing structural stability, his tenure was far from easy. Passionate Cruzeiro supporters frequently accused him of failing to inject the heavy capital investments they expected. Reflecting on his tumultuous but ultimately successful rescue mission during a press conference following the sale, Ronaldo did not mince words. "Cruzeiro was in intensive care when I came," he stated. "I halved the debts, the revenue increased five times. I am leaving Cruzeiro in a comfortable hospital bedroom now."Addressing the fierce blowback from sections of the fanbase, O Fenômeno stood firm, adding, "Maybe some have exaggerated a little going against me, but this is irrelevant to me. I know most fans are grateful to me and my team for putting Cruzeiro back in the national and international scene. My goal was reached, that was always the idea. To bring Cruzeiro back and, at the right time, give it to the right person."Ronaldo was clear that this marked the end of a specific chapter, famously declaring at the time: "My answer will be a short one; Valladolid is next. I will take some time off." True to his word, a year later on May 23, 2025, he concluded a six-year ownership tenure in Spain by selling his majority controlling stake in the second-division Spanish club Real Valladolid to a North American investment group, clearing his desk for a new chapter of global diversification.The March 2026 acquisition in Bay Harbor IslandsFree from the round-the-clock administrative pressures of running two historic football franchises, Ronaldo directed his capital toward the booming South Florida market. In March 2026, the transaction records revealed that the football legend had secured the ultimate trophy asset: the final developer-owned unit at Onda Residences, located at 1135 103rd Street.The transaction was meticulously executed, closing through a managed Delaware limited liability company under Ronaldo's direct oversight. Originally listed on the multiple listing service for $8.7 million, the luxury duplex penthouse traded hands at an adjusted $7.8 million, breaking down to an impressive $1,500 per square foot. The developers—industry titans Ugo Colombo of CMC Group and Valerio Morabito of Morabito Properties—were represented by luxury real estate agent Dina Goldentayer of Douglas Elliman, who dubbed Onda the “most luxurious building” ever built in the history of Bay Harbor Islands.Inside the penhouse: $7.8 million of pure luxuryRonaldo’s new residence is an architectural masterpiece designed for privacy, scale, and high-end living. Spanning just over 5,000 square feet of interior living space, the duplex layout boasts five expansive bedrooms and between 5.5 and 7 bathrooms, ensuring unparalleled comfort for guests and family. The interior is characterized by the flawless Italian-level craftsmanship that defines Ugo Colombo's projects, highlighting custom premium cabinetry and precision stonework.Access to the home is highly secure, featuring a private elevator that opens directly into the primary living quarters as well as directly onto the roof. The outdoor amenities include the following features:A massive 2,126-square-foot private rooftop terrace and deck space.A completely private rooftop plunge pool, entirely separate from communal building areas.Panoramic, unobstructed waterfront views looking out over Biscayne Bay.Why Onda? A boutique refuge from the skylineWhat sets Ronaldo’s new home apart from the towering skyscrapers of downtown Miami or Sunny Isles is its deliberate embrace of low-density luxury. Completed in 2024, Onda is a highly boutique, eight-story building containing just 41 total residences. Because Bay Harbor Islands enforces strict building height limits of seven to eight stories, the neighborhood avoids the disruptive shadow casting and intense traffic density found in taller coastal corridors.This creates a tranquil, European-style residential environment situated a mere 0.6 miles from the world-famous luxury retail destination, Bal Harbour Shops. While larger towers force high-net-worth individuals to share pool decks and lounge spaces, Ronaldo’s duplex penthouse delivers an entirely private open-air oasis, a configuration that remains remarkably rare and difficult to replicate anywhere along the South Florida barrier islands.The bigger picture: The global wealth migration to South FloridaRonaldo’s $7.8 million acquisition is more than just a personal real estate purchase; it is a textbook case of international wealth preservation. As real estate experts frequently note, wealthy global figures look to diversify beyond their home countries by converting corporate profits into strong, stable U.S. hard assets. South Florida has naturally evolved into the premier destination for this capital due to its accessibility, climate, and favorable lifestyle.By establishing his footprint at Onda Residences, Ronaldo joins a glittering modern migration of elite football wealth to the region, following the likes of Lionel Messi, Sergio Busquets, and the Beckham family. Following Miami's star turn as a central host city for the concluded 2026 FIFA World Cup, O Fenômeno’s move ensures that the legendary striker remains exactly where he belongs: right in the center of the action of a true global soccer capital, resting comfortably in a masterfully curated sanctuary of luxury.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Man Utd: Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann on list if Michael Carrick sacked
articles.summary: BBC Sport looks at who could replace Michael Carrick at Manchester United if the head coach is sacked.
articles.body:
Michael Carrick has left Manchester United's training ground following talks over his future, with Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann emerging as early contenders to replace him if he is sacked.

Carrick's position at Old Trafford is under major threat following the club's poor start to the season, with work towards identifying his successor believed to be ongoing.

It is understood Howe and Nagelsmann both feature prominently on the list of candidates the club has explored to potentially replace him, and that both managers are aware of United's interest.

Sources have also indicated Aston Villa boss Unai Emery is admired at United, but the fact he is under contract would complicate any move for the Spaniard.

Howe, Nagelsmann and Antonio Conte - who is interested in the job - are out of work, making their potential appointments easier.

Multiple sources have told BBC Sport that former Newcastle boss Howe is fully open to joining United if Carrick loses his job.

Nagelsmann is available after leaving his job as Germany head coach after the World Cup, while Conte - who has also been linked with Juventus - is open to returning to football after leaving Napoli in May.

Carrick left United's Carrington training ground at around 17:00 GMT on Monday.

Should he be dismissed, the 20-time English top-flight champions will be looking to appoint their eighth permanent manager or head coach since Sir Alex Ferguson departed the club in 2013 on the back of winning their most recent title.

Here, BBC Sport takes a closer look at the contenders who could be up for the job.

Why is Wilcox in line of fire from Man Utd fans?

End approaching for Carrick but Man Utd fans make clear who they blame

The Englishman has been out of work since leaving Newcastle in the summer.

Howe, 48, helped the Magpies end their 56-year wait for a trophy when he led them to League Cup glory in 2025 and secured two Champions League qualifications in his five years in charge.

The former Bournemouth and Burnley boss is available and would be considered. Sources have indicated Howe is open to returning to management with United specifically after leaving St James' Park in the close season.

The Italian has been out of work since leaving Napoli in June and is interested in the job.

Conte has won Serie A titles with three different clubs as manager - Juventus, Inter Milan and Napoli.

The 57-year-old led Chelsea to the Premier League title in 2017 and FA Cup in 2018. During his time at Tottenham between November 2021 and March 2023 he helped them qualify for the Champions League.

Also out of work, interested and high up on the club's list of contenders.

The German left the role of manager of his country's national team after a World Cup last-32 defeat on penalties to Paraguay last summer, having lost in the quarter-finals of Euro 2024 to Spain.

Nagelsmann, 39, earned his reputation as a young coach at Hoffenheim and RB Leipzig before he landed the Bayern Munich job in 2021. He led them to the Bundesliga title in 2022 but was sacked the following season amid fluctuating form.

The Aston Villa head coach's stock is high at United given how he has steered the Midlands club to Champions League qualification twice since arriving in 2022.

However, he would be difficult to prise from his current role given his contract runs until 2029.

Emery, 54, has won five Europa League trophies at Sevilla, Villarreal and at his current club while he also helped Paris St-Germain to domestic honours in a two-year stint there.

However, he lasted just 18 months at Arsenal before being sacked in 2019.

The Brighton manager is another who is well liked at Old Trafford, but the Seagulls would have little interest in discussing his availability.

It would be a difficult deal to do financially for Man Utd as well.

Hurzeler, 33, guided German club St Pauli to promotion to the Bundesliga in 2024 before he was picked up by Brighton where he is enjoying a very strong start to his third season at the club.

The former Arsenal midfielder masterminded United's humiliating 4-1 defeat in Como on Wednesday night in a game that pushed Carrick to the brink.

Fabregas, 39, is considered one of the best young coaches in Europe for his work in helping to steer the Italian club from Serie B to the Champions League and will be wanted by many major clubs in the coming months.

articles.title: Carrick, al límite: el Manchester United ya evalúa alternativas
articles.standfirst: El entrenador está muy tocado tras la mala racha de resultados en Premier y Champions
articles.summary: El entrenador está muy tocado tras la mala racha de resultados en Premier y Champions
articles.body: De héroe a villano. Después de llegar como interino el pasado curso y meter al Manchester United en Champions trans una grandísima remontada, Michael Carrick está contra las cuerdas. Los 'Red Devils' no ganan desde el pasado 10 de septiembre (4-0 al Sabah azerí en Champions) y su situación al frente del banquillo mancuniano está en serio riesgo. Tras perder 4-1 en Como el pasado martes, la derrota por 0-3 en liga ante el Bournemouth, en Old Trafford, fue la puntilla. Como informa 'Sky Sports', los directivos del Manchester United ya consideran alternativas para el puesto de entrenador. De hecho, lo hacían incluso antes de la derrota ante el Bournemouth de ayer domingo. Y es que ser protagonista del peor inicio de la historia de la Premier para un equipo glorioso como el Manchester United... es mucho decir. Una victoria, cuatro empates y tres derrotas dejan a los 'Red Devils' solamente un punto por encima del descenso. 'Sky Sports', citando fuentes del vestuario, no duda: todo apunta a que Carrick será relevado de su función como entrenador. Y cita tres nombres clave en este proceso: el director deportivo Jason Wilcox, el director ejecutivo Omar Berrada y el copropietario Sir Jim Ratcliffe. La reacción, no obstante, debe ser rápida pues el calendario del United es durísimo: visitan al Chelsea, reciben a la Roma en Champions, reciben al Aston Villa, van a Liverpool y viajan a Lisboa para medirse al Sporting CP en competición europea. Casi nada. Mientras, ya hay nombres de posibles candidatos circulando por la prensa británica. Julian Nagelsmann y Eddie Howe (ambos libres tras dejar la Selección de Alemania y el Newcastle, respectivamente) son los que más suenan pero la realidad es que incluso la candidatura de Unai Emery se ha valorado como posible opción.

articles.title: César Montes y Lokomotiv son alcanzados por ataque con drones al viajar en tren en Rusia
articles.standfirst: El equipo se trasladaba tras su partido en la liga rusa
articles.summary: El equipo se trasladaba tras su partido en la liga rusa
articles.body: César Montes y el Lokomotiv de Moscú vivieron un momento complicado cuando el tren en el que viajaban fue alcanzado por resto de un dron en un ataque en Rusia. La situación ocurrió en la región de Vorónezh, luego de que el equipo de futbol se dirigía a la capital rusa tras perder 0-2 en su visita al Rostov, donde el defensa de la Selección Mexicana no tuvo participación. Tras darse a conocer la información en los medios rusos, el Lokomotiv sacó un breve comunicado en el que anuncia que todos llegaron a salvo al club tras completar el traslado vía autobús. “Tras las informaciones difundidas por los medios, el FC Lokomotiv anuncia que el equipo ha regresado a su centro de entrenamiento con todos sus efectivos y ha comenzado la preparación para los partidos de la Copa de Rusia y el Campeonato de Rusia. ”Todos los departamentos del club respondieron con prontitud, eficiencia y profesionalidad. El FC Lokomotiv expresa su especial agradecimiento a la Liga Premier rusa y a la directiva del FC Fakel por su apoyo”, dice el comunicado. De acuerdo con información compartida por el periodista Brian McDonald, el ataque la noche del domingo dejó dos personas muertas y 17 heridos, de los cuáles cinco habrían sido en un tren. El ataque afectó la energía de las líneas aéreas, por lo que se tuvo que detener la actividad ferroviaria en la zona, esto con información por parte de Alexander Gusev, gobernador de Voronezh, y de Ferrocarriles rusos.

articles.title: Anselmi: "Un equipo ganador es el que quiere ganar siempre"
articles.standfirst: El técnico del Elche reivindica la importancia de la Copa del Rey, anuncia el debut de Kevin Lomónaco y apunta a las rotaciones para afrontar la primera eliminatoria, marcada por la cercanía del compromiso liguero en Vallecas
articles.summary: El técnico del Elche reivindica la importancia de la Copa del Rey, anuncia el debut de Kevin Lomónaco y apunta a las rotaciones para afrontar la primera eliminatoria, marcada por la cercanía del compromiso liguero en Vallecas
articles.body: Martín Anselmi no quiere confianzas en el estreno del Elche CF en la Copa del Rey. El conjunto franjiverde visita a la UD Pinatar, equipo de la Preferente murciana, en la primera eliminatoria del torneo, una cita que el entrenador argentino afronta con la máxima ambición pese a la diferencia de categoría entre ambos conjuntos. “Un equipo ganador no es aquel que gana, sino el que quiere ganar siempre. Las dinámicas positivas se alimentan”, ha afirmado Anselmi, que ha dejado claro que la competición copera tiene una importancia total para el Elche. El técnico no contempla dar por hecha la clasificación y ha insistido en la necesidad de preparar el encuentro con la misma seriedad que cualquier otro compromiso. “No creemos que la eliminatoria está ganada. Hablar de ese tipo de situaciones alimenta ruido que no viene al caso. Hay que competir y lo complicado es ganar. Si no trabajas, no se gana”, ha advertido. El entrenador franjiverde espera un rival motivado por la oportunidad de enfrentarse a un equipo de Primera División y que tratará de llevar al Elche al límite. “Para ellos enfrentarse a un rival de Primera es una motivación. He estado en la otra parte y nos clasificamos nosotros. Entiendo lo que se están jugando”, ha explicado Anselmi, que ha alertado de la velocidad del conjunto murciano en sus ataques. Por ello, ha reclamado a sus futbolistas que entren al partido “a tope”, independientemente de la categoría del adversario. La eliminatoria también servirá para repartir minutos entre los jugadores menos habituales. La proximidad del siguiente compromiso liguero, ante el Rayo Vallecano, condicionará la alineación del técnico, que confía en la profundidad de su plantilla para competir sin renunciar a la clasificación. “Cualquier jugador con menos minutos va a ser de suma importancia para rotar por la cercanía del partido en Vallecas. Somos un plantel parejo y me gustaría verlos dentro del terreno de juego. Muchos están trabajando para una oportunidad y este es un partido para ello”, ha señalado. Una de las noticias destacadas será el debut de Kevin Lomónaco, confirmado por el propio entrenador. Anselmi también ha restado importancia a la distinción entre futbolistas del primer equipo y de la cantera: “No distingo jugadores de cantera, los que entrenan todos los días son del plantel profesional”. El césped artificial será otro factor a tener en cuenta. El argentino ha reconocido que los primeros minutos pueden resultar complicados hasta acostumbrarse a la superficie, aunque considera que es un condicionante más que deberán afrontar durante el encuentro. Por último, Anselmi ha atribuido la mejoría del Elche en las últimas jornadas a la constancia y al trabajo diario. “Para conseguir cualquier cosa tienes que trabajar a diario poniendo el foco en el trabajo y no en el resultado”, ha concluido. Una filosofía que quiere trasladar también a la Copa para evitar sorpresas y mantener viva la ilusión franjiverde en el torneo.

articles.title: Eight games without a win, Manchester United face another managerial crisis as Michael Carrick comes under fire
articles.summary: Manchester United are facing the prospect of another managerial change after going eight games without a win and slipping to just above the Premier League
articles.body: Manchester United are facing the prospect of another managerial change after going eight games without a win and slipping to just above the Premier League relegation zone, with Michael Carrick's position under growing pressure.The former United midfielder received applause from fans as he walked down the tunnel after Sunday's 3-0 defeat to Bournemouth at Old Trafford. Moments later, the players were booed as they left the pitch, with supporters making their frustration clear.Carrick was given a two-year contract in May after leading an impressive revival following the team's struggles under Ruben Amorim. United finished third in the Premier League and secured a return to the Champions League. However, the team's decline this season has brought back familiar concerns for supporters, who have not seen the club win a Premier League title since Alex Ferguson's final season, 13 years ago.An emotional Carrick denied that his lap of the pitch at full-time on Sunday was a farewell gesture as he tried to make sense of the team's sudden decline."I definitely knew that we hadn't cracked it and there was a lot of work to be done, but that doesn't mean to say that it should have gone this way," he said.The 45-year-old is still in charge, but his position appears increasingly uncertain, news agency AFP reported. Former Newcastle manager Eddie Howe and ex-Germany boss Julian Nagelsmann have reportedly emerged as possible candidates to replace him.Carrick won several titles during United's successful years under Ferguson. He is the seventh permanent manager appointed since the Scot retired. The club has since turned to managers with different backgrounds, including David Moyes, who had Premier League experience, Louis van Gaal and Jose Mourinho, who had strong records, and Erik ten Hag and Amorim, who were regarded as promising coaches.Sentimental choiceCarrick's appointment has similarities with that of Ole Gunnar Solskjaer, who managed United for three years from 2018. Like Solskjaer, Carrick was a former player who had been part of the club's successful years under Ferguson, making him a popular choice among supporters."The Manchester United fans are singing the Michael Carrick song because I think they know what's going to happen here. They've seen this before. He's one of their own and he's popular," former United captain Gary Neville told Sky Sports."But the owners, the sporting department and the players are not popular and they've badly let this football club down."As Neville pointed out, United's problems extend beyond the manager.The US-based Glazer family continue to hold a majority stake in the club despite ongoing protests from supporters. Malcolm Glazer bought United through a leveraged takeover in 2005, leaving the club with huge debts.There were hopes that the arrival of British billionaire Jim Ratcliffe as a minority owner in 2024 would mark the beginning of a new era. However, those expectations have not been met.Ratcliffe has introduced cost-cutting measures, including widespread job cuts and higher ticket prices, but the club's debt has continued to rise and now stands above £1.1 billion ($1.47 billion).United, who once had the financial power to compete for the biggest names in the transfer market, also failed to sign several of their preferred targets during the summer midfield rebuild. Elliot Anderson, Sandro Tonali and Mateus Fernandes all chose other clubs.United instead signed Carlos Baleba, Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos for a combined fee of about £150 million, but none has made a strong impression so far.Tensions within the club have also come to the surface in recent weeks. Lisandro Martinez criticised director of football Jason Wilcox for not doing enough to strengthen Carrick's squad.Last week, captain Bruno Fernandes publicly questioned Carrick's tactics after United suffered a 4-1 defeat against Como, who were making their debut in the Champions League.Carrick is expected to bear the consequences of the team's poor results, but the club's return to the top appears increasingly difficult."It can't just be the manager again. There has got to be consequences above that. You can't keep letting the people pick the manager who keep getting it wrong," said Neville."It's years now without a Premier League title. That will be another five or 10 before you know it because there are other clubs set up for success and Manchester United aren't."Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: El presidente del Ceuta, "a muerte" con Romero en plena crisis
articles.standfirst: Luhay Hamido respalda públicamente al entrenador pese a los malos resultados
articles.summary: Luhay Hamido respalda públicamente al entrenador pese a los malos resultados
articles.body: El presidente del Ceuta, Luhay Hamido, ha salido públicamente al paso de los malos resultados para confirmar su respaldo absoluto a José Juan Romero. Pese a la evidente crisis deportiva que atraviesa el equipo, materializada en una tercera derrota consecutiva este pasado fin de semana y un mes de octubre para olvidar, la Directiva caballa ha decidido apostar por la continuidad del técnico de Gerena y cerrar filas en torno a su figura. Los números recientes del conjunto ceutí han encendido todas las alarmas en el entorno del Alfonso Murube. El equipo atraviesa un bache estadístico alarmante, habiendo sumado 5 puntos de los 33 posibles. Esta sangría de resultados ha comprometido seriamente la situación clasificatoria del equipo y ha situado a Romero en el centro de todas las críticas por parte de un sector de la afición y del entorno mediático. Sin embargo, Hamido ha querido cortar de raíz cualquier especulación sobre un posible relevo en el banquillo. A través de esta declaración pública a través de sus redes sociales, el máximo mandatario de la entidad envía un mensaje de tranquilidad a la plantilla y de confianza inquebrantable en el proyecto que lidera Romero, con los que está "a muerte". Desde los despachos se entiende que el técnico, artífice de éxitos pasados en el club y con tres ascensos con el club blanco a sus espaldas, sigue siendo la pieza clave y el perfil idóneo para gestionar este vestuario, revertir esta dinámica negativa y recuperar el estilo de juego característico del equipo. Con el crédito renovado desde la presidencia, el cuerpo técnico dispone ahora de un balón de oxígeno para trabajar en soluciones tácticas y anímicas. El próximo compromiso liguero el domingo en el Murube ante el Sporting se presenta como una auténtica final, no sólo por la urgencia matemática de sumar para escapar de la zona de peligro, sino como el escenario vital para que el equipo demuestre sobre el césped que la confianza depositada por la Directiva está justificada.

articles.title: El Barcelona sigue siendo el aspirante al trono de la Copa del Rey
articles.standfirst: Para Luckia es el favorito a ganar la competición
articles.summary: Para Luckia es el favorito a ganar la competición
articles.body: La Copa del Rey entra en su fase más atractiva. Entre el 27 y el 29 de octubre, los equipos de Primera División que no juegan la Supercopa se estrenan en el torneo ante rivales de menor categoría, siempre en su campo. Barcelona, Real Madrid, Atlético y Real Sociedad, los cuatro de la Supercopa, esperan hasta los dieciseisavos del 16 de diciembre. Con el torneo en marcha, el mercado de apuestas deportivas de Luckia ya tiene claro quién manda. El formato de la Copa penaliza al favorito. Cada eliminatoria es a partido único y en el campo del equipo de menor categoría, hasta las semifinales, que sí se disputan a doble partido. La final se juega en La Cartuja a finales de abril. Esa estructura multiplica las sorpresas. El curso pasado, el Espanyol cayó eliminado ante el Atlético Baleares. Los grandes tienen, eso sí, la ventaja de entrar más tarde, en una ronda con 32 equipos y con un cabeza de serie que les evita a otros rivales de Primera. El Barcelona es el gran favorito para las casas de apuestas, con una cuota de 2.6 en Luckia. La derrota reciente ante el Real Madrid en el Clásico liguero no ha cambiado esa lectura del mercado. El conjunto azulgrana había ganado sus nueve primeros partidos de Liga y anotado 39 goles, un ritmo que ningún rival igualaba. Además, llega como campeón de la edición de 2025, aunque el año pasado se quedó en semifinales, eliminado por el Atlético. Las casas de apuestas ven el tropiezo como un accidente puntual y no como un cambio de ciclo. El Real Madrid aparece como segunda opción, a cuota 3.75. Los blancos ganaron el Clásico y llegan con confianza al arranque de su Copa, aunque perdieron la final de 2025 ante el Barça. Su cuota premia la jerarquía de una plantilla acostumbrada a competir a este nivel, pero también la irregularidad que ha mostrado en ciertas fases de la temporada. El Atlético de Madrid es la tercera opción, a cuota 6.5 en Luckia. Fue finalista el año pasado y perdió en los penaltis ante la Real Sociedad, después de un 2-2 que obligó a jugar prórroga. Dominó la segunda parte de aquella final y volvió a quedarse a las puertas de un título que no gana desde 2013. La Real Sociedad defiende título y se paga a cuota 15. Superó al Athletic en las semifinales y al Atlético en la final, y tiene en Oyarzabal a un líder fiable. Su cuota refleja que el mercado duda de que pueda repetir con una plantilla con menos fondo que la de los tres favoritos. El Betis cotiza también a 15. Es un equipo con experiencia en este torneo, campeón en 2022 en La Cartuja, y acostumbra a competir bien en eliminatorias a partido único. A diferencia de los cuatro de la Supercopa, tendrá que superar la primera ronda en campo ajeno. El Athletic se sitúa a 20. El conjunto vasco conoce bien la competición, la ganó en 2024 y el año pasado llegó a semifinales. Su fortaleza en San Mamés y su cultura copera lo hacen un candidato a no descartar, aunque su cuota deja claro que parte por detrás. El Villarreal cierra la lista con una cuota de 20. Nunca ha ganado la Copa, y su camino empieza con una visita al Manacor en la primera ronda. Es una cuota larga para un equipo que puede dar guerra si evita la sorpresa temprana.

articles.title: Los mensajes de los jugadores del Barça tras el Clásico, contundentes
articles.standfirst: La plantilla no duda de su capacidad y reacción
articles.summary: La plantilla no duda de su capacidad y reacción
articles.body: Los jugadores del Barcelona son los primeros que se sienten frustrados, decepcionados y enfadados por la derrota en el Clásico de ayer domingo. Les dolió caer contra el eterno rival, y más en el Spotify Camp Nou. Pero se trata de un vestuario profesional y competitivo que no duda de su capacidad pese al revés que supone el resultado del cruce contra el Real Madrid y también el del PSG en la Champions League. Los mismos futbolistas se encargaron, en la últimas horas, de dejar claro que nadie se rinde. Y, menos, en el mes de octubre. A través de sus redes sociales alguno y otros por los medios de comunicación tradicionales, los jugadores de Hansi Flick enviaron mensajes a la grada azulgrana. La derrota en el Clásico no podrá con ellos. Las ambiciones y los objetivos no han variado: quieren conquistar todos los títulos. "Hoy, más que nunca, ¡Visca el Barça! Confiad en este equipo, culers. Queda mucho y todo vuelve'', expuso Fermín López. ''¡Seguimos, culers! ¡Força Barça!, comentó, por su parte, Eric García, que no disputó el cruce contra los de Mourinho por lesión. ''¡Esto es largo! ¡A muerte con los míos, siempre!'', trasladó Gavi. Pau Cubarsí recalcó, así mismo, la necesidad del apoyo del grada: "Una semana dura, pero no podemos bajar la cabeza. Ahora es el momento de volver aún más fuertes. Todavía queda mucho camino por recorrer en la temporada y te necesitamos, culers". Fue la misma idea que plasmó Jules Kundé. "Una semana difícil. Momento para mantenernos unidos, culers, más que nunca. No hay duda de que saldremos reforzados", indicó el defensa internacional francés. Todos tenían un discurso alineado: no bajarán los brazos pese a la dolorosa e inesperada derrota contra el Real Madrid. "No es el resultado esperado. Tenemos que levantarnos después de esta semana complicada. Tenemos equipo para lograrlo, no hay que perder la confianza", aseveró Frenkie de Jong. "Hay que reponerse. Tenemos días para pensar que hemos hecho mal. Hay que pensar en el siguiente, esto es muy largo", añadió, por su parte, Pedri. Hansi Flick les dio hoy lunes la jornada de descanso y no volverán a entrenarse hasta el miércoles. El técnico alemán confía en que estos dos días sirvan para que su plantilla no sólo descanse físicamente sino también mentalmente: aspira a ganar los tres encuentros que restan antes del próximo parón por los partidos de los combinados nacionales.

articles.title: England-Republic of Ireland Under-15 World Cup match abandoned over alleged racism
articles.summary: The Under-15 World Cup Group C match between England and Republic of Ireland is abandoned after England allege an opposition player made a racist comment.
articles.body:
England walked off the pitch during a match at the Under-15 World Cup after an allegation of racism by a Republic of Ireland player, which resulted in the game being abandoned.

Following an altercation between players from both sides, shortly before the end of the match in Azerbaijan on Monday, an England player approached his bench and made a complaint to coaching staff.

Match footage then showed England staff members relaying the complaint to the referee, alleging a racist slur had been said, and calling their players off.

The Republic of Ireland were leading 4-1 at the time of the incident.

World governing body Fifa told BBC Sport it is investigating and gathering reports.

"Fifa is aware of an incident at the U-15 World Cup and Festival match between England and the Republic of Ireland," a spokesperson said.

"The match was abandoned by the referee following England's refusal to continue.

"The official reports are being gathered, and the matter will be referred to the independent disciplinary committee, who will decide in due course."

The Football Association (FA) told BBC Sport it is awaiting more information and was in touch with Fifa, adding the wellbeing of players is a priority.

The Football Association of Ireland (FAI) has also been contacted for comment.

The alleged incident happened in the final minute of the Group C match in Baku.

Immediately following the allegation, England head coach Matt Thorpe was seen on the match coverage on DAZN asking for the referee to come over, before calling his players off the pitch.

After an initial report from Thorpe, the referee told England's coaching staff, "I cannot hear".

One of Thorpe's assistant coaches can then be heard telling the referee "we are reporting racism", before adding "we do not want to play".

When another official came over, talking about what would happen after the match, the assistant told him: "No, our players do not want to play".

He was later heard saying that a player was "upset".

Heated words were then exchanged between each set of coaching staff, with both saying they were trying to protect their players.

This is the first time the U15 World Cup and Festival has been played, and involves 189 countries and territories.

Matches are played in an eight-a-side format, on smaller pitches, with 20-minute halves.

England are scheduled to play their next match against Zimbabwe at 20:45 local time (16:45 GMT) on Monday, with Republic of Ireland facing Cambodia at the same time.

articles.title: Almeida reconoce un error de cálculo en la recalificación de terrenos del Real Madrid en Valdebebas
articles.summary: El alcalde de Madrid, José Luis Martínez Almeida, ha reconocido este lunes que el error de cálculo detectado en el informe económico sobre la recalificación de los terrenos del Real Madrid en Valdebebas "es un error material" que no tiene consecuencias prácticas y no "frustra" la operación
articles.body: El alcalde de Madrid, José Luis Martínez Almeida, ha reconocido este lunes que el error de cálculo detectado en el informe económico sobre la recalificación de los terrenos del Real Madrid en Valdebebas "es un error material" que no tiene consecuencias prácticas y no "frustra" la operación Almeida ha respondido así a los periodistas tras la información publicada por El País, sobre un error de cálculo detectado en el informe económico sobre la recalificación de los terrenos del Real Madrid en Valdebebas, un fallo que eleva de 1,46 a 98,6 millones de euros el beneficio anual previsto para las arcas municipales por la operación. Para el primer edil madrileño se trata de un error sin consecuencias por una razón. "Porque -ha apuntado- esos 98 millones no se iban a cobrar, nosotros siempre cobramos en función de lo que es el porcentaje y de lo que es el tipo de impositivo. El error no es sobre el tipo de impositivo, sino sobre el coeficiente que se ha calculado. Por tanto, no hay ninguna pérdida económica real para el Ayuntamiento de Madrid". Eso sí, ha admitido el error en "un punto" y que el consistorio, por lo tanto, seguirá los trámites pertinentes: "Pero esto no frustra la operación, que es buena para la ciudad. "Hay algunos que se van a agarrar como un clavo ardiendo, pero hay un error indiscutible. El error no tiene ninguna repercusión material sobre las cuentas del Ayuntamiento porque íbamos a cobrar lo que hay que cobrar, no lo que ponía en ese informe y por tanto, desde ese punto de vista haremos la rectificación y cumplimos los trámites adecuados", ha subrayado. Según la información publicada, el error figura en el estudio económico encargado por el Ayuntamiento a la consultora Savills para evaluar la viabilidad de la operación urbanística. El informe calcula los ingresos municipales que generaría el proyecto, pero aplica incorrectamente el porcentaje del impuesto sobre actividades económicas (IAE) previsto para los futuros alquileres. La equivocación hace que la recaudación anual estimada por ese tributo pase de unos 980.000 euros a cerca de 98 millones. Al corregir el cálculo, el beneficio anual previsto para el Ayuntamiento, una vez descontados los gastos, se reduce de casi 100 millones a 1,46 millones de euros. La recalificación, aprobada inicialmente por la Junta de Gobierno municipal este verano, afecta a los terrenos de la ciudad deportiva del Real Madrid en Valdebebas, de unos 1,2 millones de metros cuadrados, donde el club prevé desarrollar un complejo con oficinas, hoteles, un hospital privado, residencias de estudiantes, centros educativos y comercios.

articles.body: El celtismo siempre ha soñado con que Iago Aspas levantase un título para el Celta y que el camino menos complejo para conseguirlo era la Copa del Rey. articles.title: FAW sets out ambition 10-year plan but says it needs more money
articles.summary: The Football Association of Wales has called for greater funding for Welsh football after setting out ambitious targets for the next decade.
articles.body:
The Football Association of Wales (FAW) has called for greater funding for Welsh football after setting out ambitious targets for the next decade.

Wales' governing body says it wants more players, more pitches and more qualifications for major tournaments over the next ten years.

The FAW's aims have been outlined in a new strategic plan that includes seeing the men's national side return to the top 20 of Fifa's world rankings.

Their plan – Llunio Cymru – sets out a number of measures of success between now and 2036, all based on growing participation and helping the national sides "perform on the world stage".

A key goal includes ensuring "quality" facilities are in place "within 15 minutes of every community" with a target of 100 new or upgraded pitches by 2030.

But chief executive Noel Mooney admits the association will seek greater Welsh government support to develop new facilities, as it aims to increase the number of registered players in Wales by 30%.

"We need a lot more support," said Mooney.

"We're very clear on the growth of the female game that we need facilities for that. We've spent more than £30m over the last four years building pitches all across the country but we've a long, long way to go.

"Thankfully, our resources are increasing - which is good - but we really need more support from Welsh government and from the 22 local authorities to deliver this."

FAW posts loss for 2025 despite record revenue

Welsh football bosses reveal cost to improve facilities

FAW CEO Noel Mooney on Bellamy, FIFA and the grassroots game

Club academies key to world ranking plans

Key targets for the elite game include qualifying for every other major tournament and reaching the knockout stages of the co-hosted Euro 2028 and 2035 Women's World Cup.

The FAW wants 80% of men's and women's national team players to be regular starters in the world's top five leagues, with the men's squad currently at 65%.

One plan to achieve that is the introduction of two elite category club academies in the country, having admitted there has been a drop-off in talent produced for the men's national side following Swansea City's loss of category one status.

Now the FAW said it will work with clubs to lend resources and staff and boost chances of new talent emerging – with an aim of producing two players per team every year.

In the meantime, the FAW said it has developed data tracking of dual-qualified players and continue work on the national academies for the women's game.

But the aims are underpinned by a long-term focus to grow the number of people playing the game.

The FAW last set out targets in 2021. Qualification for the 2022 men's World Cup and the 2025 women's Euros were two key goals ticked.

They also hit goals for increasing the number of people playing the sport, with the registered players count rising from 80,0000 to 120,0000.

The FAW now want that number to grow to 160,000, including doubling the number of registered women and girls to 40,0000.

They believe increasing playing numbers will help the top level while also boosting the nation's health – with the need for more facilities key.

Projects in the 100 most deprived and diverse communities will be a priority, as well as a 50% increase in priority pitch access for women and girls.

A specific strategy for the women and girls' game will be launched next month, and it will include doubling the money invested.

Delivering the facilities needed by local authority areas would cost an estimated £150m, according to a recent review .

Mooney says increased revenues from Fifa after the 2026 World Cup, and the planned windfall from staging Euro 2028, has helped the FAW nudge towards revenues of £50m.

But he hopes the forthcoming Welsh government budget – the first since Plaid Cymru's election success earlier this year – will bring increased investment in capital projects.

The FAW has secured UK government funding for some of its plans, but Mooney believes the Welsh government must now do more, describing the current £13m in capital expenditure as "a scratch on the surface of what we need to get to".

"We've got confidence. We've had a lot of discussions with the new government and they've given us all of the signals that we're going in the right direction," he added.

Mooney says football's place in preventative health was key, and noted that allocating greater resources was "a no-brainer".

Other key aims include ensuring every match above under-12 level has a qualified, neutral referee, halving teenage drop-out rates, increasing the number of qualified coaches by a third and lifting average Cymru Premier attendances above 1,000.

articles.title: Melanie Leupolz, sobre su etapa en el Real Madrid: "Parecía que daba un billón de pases cada día..."
articles.standfirst: La alemana jugó también en el Bayern de Múnich, próximo rival de las blancas en la UWCL
articles.summary: La alemana jugó también en el Bayern de Múnich, próximo rival de las blancas en la UWCL
articles.body: El Real Madrid visita este miércoles (18:45 horas) el Stadion Am Sportpark de Unterhaching para medirse al Bayern de Múnich en la tercera jornada de la Fase Liga de la Champions League. Melanie Leupolz, quien fuera jugadora de ambos equipos (entre 2014-2020 en el Bayern y entre 2024-2025 en el Real Madrid) habla del duelo entre las dos grandes potencias. "Será un encuentro fascinante. El Bayern ha progresado muchísimo, sobre todo en los últimos dos o tres años, y en competiciones europeas. El equipo tiene mucha experiencia, lleva jugando al máximo nivel durante muchos años y tiene la calidad para ser protagonista en Europa. Este desarrollo no ha sido repentino, sino que se ha gestado a lo largo de muchos años. Cuando pienso en dónde empezó y dónde está ahora el club, es realmente impresionante", asegura en una entrevista concedida a la web del club bávaro. "Al Real Madrid quizás todavía le falten algunos años de experiencia. El equipo femenino no lleva tanto tiempo existiendo, además de que hubo otra reestructuración en verano. Depende en gran medida de jugadores jóvenes y talentosos. Es gratificante ver la calidad que está surgiendo en ambos clubes", subraya. "Lo pasé de maravilla en ambos clubes y tengo muchas ganas de reencontrarme con viejos conocidos en el campo. Espero que ambos equipos lleguen lejos en la Champions. Ahora puedo ver esta competición con una perspectiva más neutral. Tengo una estrecha relación con ambos clubes", añade. Leupolz jugó 27 partidos con el Real Madrid en los que anotó un gol. "Disfruté mucho jugando en España. Vengo de Inglaterra, donde el fútbol suele ser más físico, con balones largos y entradas fuertes. En España, al principio tuve que acostumbrarme a tener mucha posesión. Mis aductores sufrieron al principio; parecía que daba un billón de pases cada día [Risas]. Al mismo tiempo, ese tipo de fútbol me daba mucho placer. Se trataba de pases cortos, mantener la posesión y encontrar soluciones en equipo. Disfrutaba mucho del fútbol de posesión. Creo que la Liga alemana está un poco más equilibrada, tanto en cuanto al nivel de los equipos como al profesionalismo en general. Han pasado muchas cosas positivas aquí en los últimos años", asevera. Aunque tiene compatriotas en el Real Madrid como Merle Frohms, Elisa Senß y Sara Däbritz, Leupolz destaca a Felicia Schröder como jugadora a seguir en el conjunto blanco. "Aunque no jugué con Felicia, creo que tiene un talento impresionante. Lo que está haciendo esta temporada —la cantidad de goles que marca y su velocidad y fuerza física— es extraordinario. Aporta mucho y es un placer verla jugar. Creo que el Bayern debe vigilarla de cerca. Las jugadoras jóvenes pueden ser especialmente peligrosas con esa exuberancia. No está constantemente pensando en todo lo que está en juego, sino que simplemente juega con valentía y libertad", analiza. Melanie colgó las botas en junio de 2025 tras una carrera en la que ganó dos Ligas alemanas, tres inglesas, tres FA Cup y dos League Cup. "El mayor cambio fue, obviamente, el paso de ser profesional a la vida después del deporte: cuándo te levantas, cuándo entrenas, cuándo juegas, cuándo te recuperas. Durante mi carrera como jugadora, cada día estaba minuciosamente planeado. Ahora puedo decidir por mí misma cuándo me reúno con amigos o celebro cumpleaños y bodas, sin pensar de antemano si tengo entrenamiento o partido próximamente. Lo disfruto muchísimo", resume. "Ahora mi segundo hijo marca el ritmo. Con un recién nacido, vuelves a vivir en una especie de rueda de hámster: cambiar pañales, comer y beber, dormir… todo eso. Obviamente es maravilloso y disfruto mucho de esta etapa. Al mismo tiempo, es una vida completamente diferente, una vida maravillosa para mí. Siempre quise que mis hijos no se llevaran mucha diferencia de edad, así que estoy muy contenta con cómo están las cosas ahora", sentencia.

articles.title: Celtic & Rangers wait for stadium closures ruling after appeals
articles.summary: Rangers and Celtic submit appeals against a ruling that they must play their next home Scottish Cup ties behind closed doors following scenes of disorder in last season's competition.
articles.body:
Rangers and Celtic are waiting for a Scottish FA appellate tribunal to rule on their respective appeals against an order that they must play their next home Scottish Cup ties behind closed doors.

The Glasgow clubs presented their cases on Monday and the tribunal will now undertake a period of deliberation before announcing whether the sanctions stand.

The stadium closure penalty was announced in late August following the disorder at the end of last season's quarter-final tie at Ibrox, which Celtic won after a penalty shoot-out.

They clubs are also challenging fines of £100,000 after their fans clashed on the Ibrox pitch.

Supporters threw fireworks and other missiles and police officers were injured, while 43 arrests had been made by 25 August.

Both clubs were warned that they could be forced play a second home match without supporters in the event of further unacceptable conduct.

An independent review published in July concluded the incident "came within a very small margin of becoming a violent mass confrontation".

The report, led by Mark Blackbourne, identified failings by both clubs and criticised the SFA for not taking a tougher approach to crowd disorder.

An agreement was reached in September to have no away fans at any of the Old Firm derbies in this season's SPFL competitions.
